findings.title: Provision and personal access form one conditional boundary
findings.claim: The condition joins the measured grain allocation to personal access: provision is held within the speaker's domain, and approach to that domain is closed until the requested person is brought.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers كَيْلَ, عِندِي, and تَقْرَبُونِ connect measured food, the speaker's controlled sphere, and approach. The independent measure and authority connections make the ration an administered due, while the approach connections make access a separately governed privilege; together they change the sentence from a single denial into a two-layer boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see why the two sanctions are stated together: the condition governs both what the brothers receive and whether they may come near the person who controls it.
findings.containment: The finding preserves the ordinary conditional warning about bringing the brother and does not replace the plain ration meaning with an abstract access metaphor or claim that the human administrator has ultimate authority.

epistemic.reason: A trusted cross-run support binds all four focus branches to exact carriers; connection rows are used for their stated contextual relations, without importing their un supplied target morphology.

branch_activations.activation: The locative carrier meets the independently supplied administrative-authority trigger, so with me becomes a controlled provision domain rather than a filler for the translation.

branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the focus locative alone means legal custody or that the connection supplies a new lexicon branch.

findings.title: Arrival functions as embodied proof
findings.claim: Bringing the requested brother to the speaker functions as an embodied credential that reconnects the brothers to both measured provision and access.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier تَأْتُونِي بِهِ expresses bringing a person to the speaker, while the focus measure and approach occurrences provide the paired consequences. The later 12:78 connection returns to the same brother condition under material pressure, so a person's arrival becomes the check that changes eligibility.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the condition as a verifiable presence requirement: a promise about the brother is converted into a person who can be presented.
findings.containment: The reading adds a credentialing function to the ordinary demand to bring the brother. It does not turn the verb into a general legal test or claim that the packet proves the later capture procedure was already planned.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk support is legacy-unbound, but the focus carrier, paired sanctions, and a later same-surah connection provide an explicit bounded relation.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sanction operates as a proof-of-presence rule that governs both ration and approach.
branch_activations.boundary: The supplied form supports coming or bringing; it does not by itself establish a general credentialing lexeme or settle the later procedure's original intent.

findings.title: The access ban becomes a staged sequence
findings.claim: The approach prohibition is later answered first by private brotherly shelter and then by a public legal sequence, so the initial closure remains forceful while becoming one stage in a controlled access process.

The retrospective support names 12:69 and 12:70 as later contact points; their sequence changes the reading of the ban from a terminal exclusion into a condition that is fulfilled and then converted into a new legal arrangement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold the sharpness of the initial refusal together with the later scene in which proximity is granted and made operational.
findings.containment: The retrospective source is not a proof that the full procedure was already intended at 12:60. The finding preserves the focus warning and reports the later transformation as a qualified narrative relation.

epistemic.reason: A specific retrospective walk supplies the later ayah contacts, but it is legacy-unbound and provides no full context word-level projection.

findings.title: Measure and approach are one controlled boundary
findings.claim: The final approach ban is the relational counterpart of denying the measure, so the ayah closes both access to provision and access to the speaker under one condition.
findings.mechanism: The focus approach carrier تَقْرَبُونِ meets the independently supplied measure occurrence and the wider sequence of hospitality at 12:59, negotiation at 12:61, and returned goods at 12:62. This contact changes the final prohibition from a redundant second refusal into the boundary governing the whole exchange.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sentence's two negatives as coordinated gates around a relationship, not as one material denial followed by an unrelated spatial warning.
findings.containment: The wide reader-walk is qualified and does not eliminate the ordinary spatial approach sense. It also does not assert that all later story events are encoded in this one clause.

epistemic.reason: The wide reader-walk supplies explicit context contacts and a focus branch, but its source is legacy-unbound and citable false.

findings.title: Restricted access later opens into safe admission
findings.claim: The access threatened as closed at 12:60 is later reversed when the whole family enters Egypt safely, so the initial exclusion becomes a controlled stage on the way to comprehensive admission.
findings.mechanism: The focus approach carrier تَقْرَبُونِ names the withheld access. The exact 12:99 connection supplies the independent later entry and explicitly describes it as the reversal of the prohibited access, returning the wider event through the focus word.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive the ban as a real present boundary whose later opening changes its narrative reach without weakening its force at the focus.
findings.containment: The wide retrospective source and weak connection row are qualified evidence. They do not prove that 12:60 announces the ending or that the earlier condition was merely symbolic.

epistemic.reason: The retrospective walk is legacy-unbound, while the packet also supplies an exact 12:99 Arabic target and a stated reversal relation without target-side morphology.
